posts.title: Do fireplaces need to be inspected?
posts.excerpt: A fireplace inspection protects your home, prevents chimney fires, and identifies repairs early. Learn what inspectors check, how often you need one in Columbus, and who to call.

posts.title: What is included in a fireplace inspection?
posts.excerpt: A professional fireplace inspection checks the chimney structure, flue, damper, firebox and gas connections to confirm safe, efficient operation. Read what inspectors look for in Columbus homes.
